observed_content: Assume each new generation costs one unit plus one per predecessor. C(m)=m(m+1)/2, maximum m=floor((sqrt(8X+1)-1)/2). Alternative directed pair accounting C(m)=m² gives floor(sqrt(X)); constant marginal cost gives m=X. Combined with A1 invariant multiplicity m+1, this implies square-root scaling under quadratic accounting.
